data.one_liner: Framework for building plugins for the Dart analysis server
data.what_it_does: Provides support code and mixins to help write plugins that run in the analysis server. It handles isolate communication and plugin discovery.
use_when: You need to extend the legacy analysis server with custom plugins
You are maintaining an existing plugin that depends on this package
avoid_when: You are starting a new plugin project
You need modern, actively maintained plugin support
strengths: Legacy compatibility with older analysis server versions
Built-in mixins and helpers for plugin development

alternatives.name: analysis_server_plugin
alternatives.why_pick_it: Modern, actively maintained plugin framework for the analysis server
